title: MCP++ A2A ProfileRequest@1
description: Client request profile claim checked against agent-advertised profiles under the MCP++ A2A execution extension. Unsupported profile letters (unknown enum or not advertised) MUST fail closed — never silently claim success. Interface: A2AExtensionSchema@1. Normative prose: a2a-extension.md §4.1, §8.
$comment: Schema marker: mcp++/a2a/profile-request@1. Structural validation covers closed profile letters; subset-of-advertised is an additional semantic rule for adapters/vectors.

extension_uri.description: Activated extension URI for this profile claim.

advertised_profiles.description: Profiles the agent advertises in AgentExtension.params.profiles.

requested_profiles.description: Profiles the client requests in Task/Message metadata. Each entry MUST be a known profile letter; adapters MUST also require subset of advertised_profiles.
